title: SWE-at-Scale: Scalable Issue Synthesis from Historical Bug Fixes
abstract: arXiv:2610.21359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As coding agents become increasingly capable, robust evaluation requires a broader and more diverse supply of verifiable software engineering (SWE) tasks. However, real-world tasks are constrained by the natural frequency of issue reporting and the substantial cost of manual curation. Furthermore, existing synthetic approaches rely primarily on the pretrained knowledge of large models coupled with heuristic prompting, often failing to capture the authentic, complex mechanics of software failures. To exponentially scale SWE task production, we introduce SWE-at-Scale, a framework that automatically synthesizes realistic issues by reverse-engineering real-world software fixes. Our key insight is that historical fixes encapsulate deep mechanistic knowledge of bug formation: inverting a fix transforms repair supervision into bug-induction supervision grounded in actual development scenarios. translated_title: SWE-at-Scale：基于历史缺陷修复的可扩展问题合成
translated_abstract: 随着编码智能体能力的不断提升，稳健的评估需要更广泛、更多样化的可验证软件工程（SWE）任务供给。然而，现实世界的任务受到问题报告自然频率以及人工整理高昂成本的制约。此外，现有的合成方法主要依赖大模型的预训练知识并结合启发式提示，往往无法捕捉软件故障真实而复杂的机制。为了指数级地扩展SWE任务的生产规模，我们提出了SWE-at-Scale，一个通过逆向工程真实世界软件修复来自动合成真实问题的框架。我们的关键洞察在于：历史修复蕴含着关于缺陷形成机制的深层知识——对修复进行逆向推导，可以将修复监督转化为基于实际开发场景的缺陷诱导监督。SWE-at-Scale将这些学到的缺陷模式进行迁移……
tldr: 该论文提出SWE-at-Scale框架，通过逆向工程历史软件修复将“修复监督”转化为“缺陷诱导监督”，自动合成真实可验证的软件工程任务，实现SWE任务生产的指数级扩展。
en_tdlr: SWE-at-Scale automatically synthesizes realistic, verifiable software engineering issues by reverse-engineering historical bug fixes—converting repair supervision into bug-induction supervision—to exponentially scale the production of SWE evaluation tasks.
